This is a mid-level backend software engineering role (2+ years of experience) at Robinhood, working on the brokerage, incentives, or identity systems behind its consumer trading and financial products. The work involves designing and owning scalable backend services, infrastructure, and data systems for things like trading infrastructure, rewards platforms, or KYC and fraud prevention. The core stack is Go or Python with Kafka or similar streaming technologies and large-scale data processing, with Postgres, Kubernetes, Redis, and AWS as adjacent technologies.
